title: Sea freight kit arrives at the circuit
detail: Garage and hospitality kit shipped by sea ahead of the fly-away rounds. Moving freight from air to sea is the lever the team credits with more than 1,500 tCO2e saved between 2022 and 2023.

title: Air freight lands at Changi
detail: Race-critical parts fly in. The team's SAF certificates cut associated air-freight emissions by 31% in 2025.

title: Pit Lane Classroom opens
detail: First cohort of Singapore secondary students arrives for AI-in-strategy workshops with Cognizant volunteers.

title: Second classroom cohort
detail: Afternoon session for a school group from the east of the island.

title: Marina Bay shoreline clean-up
detail: Fans and team volunteers log their first hours on the shoreline.

title: Data gap: Singapore trackside energy
detail: Trackside energy is published for nine European rounds but not for Singapore. Flagged for the partner data team.

title: Women in engineering breakfast
detail: Mentoring breakfast for engineering students, modelled on the Accelerate Women programme.

title: Fans choose the MRT
detail: A wave of fans pledges a low-carbon trip to the circuit in the app.

title: Pit Lane Classroom: final cohort
detail: The last school group of the week completes the programme.

title: Share cards spike
detail: Fans post their Weekend in Impact cards before qualifying.

title: Race-day pledges
detail: Race-day crowd pledges low-carbon travel home.

title: Pack-down begins
detail: Garage kit is packed for the next fly-away round.

title: Volunteer wrap-up
detail: Final volunteering hours logged for the weekend.
